address: Building 4, Dubai Hills Estate Business Park, Dubai Hills, Dubai
bio: This relaxing and casual restaurant, set within Dubai Hills Business Park, is another venture from notable local chef, Reif Othman. A playful and colourful space with Korean elements adorning the walls, the contemporary Korean eatery specialises in barbecue, with a nice selection of wagyu beef and a noteworthy marinated grilled salmon dish paired with gochujang sauce. Prices are good, especially the business lunch. Expect warm service from the attentive and smiling team....
